semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company primarily focuses on providing investor services and public aid for new investment projects rather than manufacturing or supplying semiconductor products.
summary: Pomeranian Special Economic Zone Ltd. facilitates investment in the Pomeranian and Kuyavian-Pomeranian regions of Poland by offering comprehensive investor services, including income tax exemptions for new projects. Their Gdansk Science and Technology Park supports the development of high technology sectors, fostering innovation and business development.

regional_presence.Poland: The company operates in the Pomeranian and Kuyavian-Pomeranian regions, supporting both domestic and foreign investment projects.
